<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py from workflow.yaml. -->

Build the product from architecture to reviewed, tested increments: ADRs, API and data design, threat model, implementation slices in isolated worktrees, independent code review, test execution and the build gate, with human approval before any production action.

**Trigger:** PRD and design exist and the software must be implemented or substantially changed.
